url.description: Direct Streamable HTTP MCP endpoint (HTTP(S) with host, not legacy /sse); mutually exclusive with configPath/server. No embedded credentials or configured auth headers. Private/loopback hosts allowed, redirects disabled. Use a trusted endpoint; configPath+server supports configured headers.

configPath.description: Explicit MCP config path (relative to host workspace or absolute). Optional; defaults to automatic config discovery. Mutually exclusive with url. Use trusted configs.

server.description: Exact enabled mcpServers key. Supply it to list tools on one configured server.

action.description: list (default) lists server names or discovers tools. close requires server or url and releases its session connection and subscriptions.

timeoutSeconds.description: Per-request deadline in seconds (1-300) for targeted discovery. Defaults to the configured timeout or 60 for a direct URL. For probe, bounds the page (default 15 seconds).

tools.description: Exact tool names to describe. Omit for a compact catalog. Only selected tools get projected schemas.

detail.description: Return original schemas for the requested tools or current page.

offset.description: Continue a tool catalog or probe using nextOffset.

probe.description: Probe configured servers concurrently for tool counts and failures. Omit for a configuration-only listing that starts no servers.
